messages:
priya: kicking off a quick thread to align on the observability beta scope for Console. customer asks we need to bake into the beta: per-route cost breakdown, error analytics by model+version, and tracing hooks for cold-starts. we also need clear launch criteria for a canary rollout. thoughts?

mike: +1. engineering note — we can produce per-route cost using sampling and routing metadata, but exact per-token accounting will be heavier. propose sampled estimates for beta.

sam: tracing hooks are doable but we should add sampling config & backpressure to avoid telemetry storms. SDK change is small (inject trace-id + optional span). biggest risk is volume from some high-traffic routes.

elaine: from UX: please keep dashboard default simple. show high-level cost summary and top-5 costly routes, then let users drill into traces/errors. avoid dumping raw metrics by default.

jon-ops: one ops concern: for Dedicated customers we need SLA-triggered alerts and playbooks. are we committing to alerting in beta or alpha?

priya: good point. proposed launch criteria for beta (draft): 1) per-route cost summary in Console (sampled, with confidence intervals) 2) trace hooks and sampling controls in SDK + docs 3) basic error analytics: error rate by model+version, top error messages, and ability to filter by route 4) rollback/canary plan + runbook documented and tested. any objections?

mike: timeline estimate: hosted-only MVP is ~2 sprints if we scope sampling and UI drilldowns. integrating Dedicated (KMS/audit/etc) adds another sprint for ops hooks.

sam: blocker: we need immutable request IDs for cross-service correlation (not all clients send one). infra change to add uuid at edge if missing. can we add that to infra backlog?

priya: yes i'll add it. to keep beta tractable, can we defer detailed long-tail query breakdown (per-token per-customer) to post-beta? keep beta focused on top routes + sampled estimates.

elaine: +1 to deferring. Recommend these beta dashboard cards: Total cost (24h/7d), Cost by route (top 5), 90p latency by route, Error rate by model. clickable row -> traces.

priya: perfect. @jon-ops can you own the rollout playbook? need canary percentages, escalation flows, and cost guardrails.

jon-ops: yep. proposed canary: 5% traffic for 24-48h, monitor cost spike and error delta; if stable bump to 25% for 48h then full. escalation: on >x% error increase or >y% cost increase auto-fallback to previous model. will draft runbook.

infra-bot: deploy pipeline scheduled: CI #842 -> staging -> canary window target 1757730000 :rocket:

priya: thanks. i'll write the formal spec and launch criteria doc and open a PR by EOD tomorrow. also will include a small SDK example for trace sampling:```js
// attach trace id and sampling flag
fetch('/api/generate', {headers: { 'x-trace-id': 'req-{{uuid}}', 'x-trace-sample': '1' }})
```

mike: once spec PR is up I can break into engineering tickets and estimate precisely.

sam: will add the SDK change and sampling config to our sprint board.

priya: cool — action items: priya write spec + PR; mike ticketize and estimate; sam implement SDK change; jon-ops write runbook + canary config; elaine mockups for dashboard cards. thanks all :thumbsup:

elaine: adding a short UX checklist to the doc: clear drill paths, default sample rates, permission access for cost views.

priya: great. if no objections i'll lock this scope for beta and we can re-evaluate after the spec PR.

mike: no objections from infra side.

jon-ops: no objections from ops.

sam: no objections.

priya: 👍 closing thread, moving to PR.
